subject: general
question: An electric motor is a device which converts:
solution:
The correct answer is __**electrical energy into mechanical energy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• An electric motor is a device that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.
 
• It operates on the principle of electromagnetic induction.
 
• Electric motors are widely used in industrial, commercial, and residential applications.
 
• Common examples include fans, pumps, electric vehicles, and household appliances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electromagnetic Induction:** The process by which a conductor placed in a changing magnetic field causes the production of a voltage across the conductor.
 
• **Types of Electric Motors:** There are various types of electric motors including DC motors, AC motors, synchronous motors, and induction motors.
 
• **Applications of Electric Motors:** Electric motors are used in various applications such as home appliances (refrigerators, washing machines), industrial machinery (conveyors, pumps), and transportation (electric vehicles, trains).
 
• **Maintenance of Electric Motors:** Regular maintenance of electric motors includes checking for wear and tear, lubrication of moving parts, and ensuring proper electrical connections to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
